submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production combat animation sprite frame for 五行奇谈 pet 芽铃童.
Input images: Image 1 is the canonical FRONT identity, use only to preserve anatomy/costume/props. Image 2 is canonical W REAR identity and this exact diagonal rear camera and facing must control the output. Image 3 is the PRIMARY approved painted finish, material and art style reference only, do not depict its UI or text.
Output exactly ONE new independent pose of this SAME acorn-helmet child, no sheet, no panels. 1024x1024 transparent RGBA PNG, real transparent background, no floor, no shadow plane, no labels. Clean luminous rounded Chinese Daoist chibi hand-painted rendering matching the native character; intricate acorn wood, green cloth, warm-gold small metal bell mouths.
LOCKED W camera: true three-quarter REAR view facing upper-left northwest, back of head, back collar and back tunic, backs/heels of boots remain visible. NEVER show front chest/fastenings or a front face, never mirror the front. The head/body/camera must maintain the same orientation as Image 2.
Identity: brown short hair; one acorn helmet with its same single woody sprout and leaves, no additional leaves branches flowers horns; moss-green short tunic with ivory cuffs and hem; dark brown loose short trousers; ivory shin wraps; brown short boots. Exactly two arms/hands, two legs/feet, zero wings/horns/tails.
Exactly TWO brown seed-yoyo bells, EACH with green leaf cap, little golden bead and gold bell opening, exactly one separate cord per bell, one cord held in each fist. Right anatomical hand on screen RIGHT owns right bell; left anatomical hand on screen LEFT owns left bell. Two seed pouches at anatomical right waist (screen RIGHT), red knot/tassel at anatomical left waist (screen LEFT). Keep each bell distinct throughout spell, never a shared cord, third bell, flower, staff or extra hand.
Fixed framing: sprout highest point about y=100, boots support anchor midpoint [512,942], full sprite all bells within image. Same head size and child proportions throughout the animation. Both feet stay planted in the same stance, natural knees/ankles/boot axes, no walking or root translation. Arms and wrists perform the magic; body can crouch subtly.

CRITICAL FIXED STANCE: Match Image 2 leg perspective exactly: anatomical RIGHT boot is the nearer SCREEN-RIGHT boot, its sole bottom at y=942 (roughly x=650); anatomical LEFT boot is the farther SCREEN-LEFT boot, its sole at y=860 (roughly x=410). Never reverse which boot is lower/nearer, never step one leg past the other, never swap supporting legs. Both boots point northwest with heels visible. The left boot must NEVER be lower in the image than the right boot. Keep reference boot pose while only arms change.

For feet correct the native reference's ambiguous toe perspective: both boot TOES point to UPPER LEFT, hidden partly beyond the shins, while rounded HEELS face lower-right toward viewer. No toe sticking toward screen-right, no front-facing toe cap or crossed ankle. Keep hip-knee-ankle-foot mechanically aligned northwest; near right boot heel remains the lower foot. Camera fixed.

Current cast W frame 07 both arms start opening outward in a balanced resonating posture. The two bells move apart, one on each side, at upper waist/chest-side height. A few very small jade-green and warm-gold light specks around each bell only. No large aura.
FOOT DETAIL: Both toes are hidden AWAY FROM CAMERA toward northwest. The viewer sees vertical back seams on both rounded HEELS. Both shoe silhouettes should extend UP-LEFT of their shins. No shoe silhouette extends out toward screen-right. Natural parallel lower limb axes.
Single isolated frame duration 45ms, no montage. Deliver fine clean alpha edge.
